name: Akuma o Daite Nemure
source:
Main character Setsuna is a 19-year-old young man who serves as a deputy director of the Jinryu Karate Dojo. His defeated contestant immediately applies for rematch, but director forbids it. Setuna lives with the contestant for a week in attempt to persuade him drop the claim.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角刹那是一位十九岁的年轻人，担任神龙空手道道场的副道长。被击败的选手立即申请重赛，但导演禁止。塞图纳与参赛者住了一个星期，试图说服他放弃这一主张。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
